unit_statements_verbatim: The total unit requirement for the minor is 20 units; 16 of those units must be upper-division.

sections.title: (preamble)

notes.text: Students taking the Jewish studies minor must enroll in either JS 100 or JS 180 . In addition, they must complete four upper-division courses selected from the Judaism as a Religious Tradition track and the Jewish History and Culture track listed in the Jewish studies major description.
